\paragraph{Limitations of the episode-level fix.}
Episode-level training is not a complete solution. It assigns uniform credit to all tokens, which becomes increasingly wasteful as episodes grow longer and the policy improves. At $p{=}90\%$ (our 8B endpoint), most trajectories succeed and the gradient signal primarily distinguishes ``good enough'' from ``slightly better,'' where per-step credit would provide more useful signal. Additionally, episode-level training requires $O(T)$ memory per sequence, which may be prohibitive for environments with very long trajectories ($T > 1000$).
